scope: Product fixes for the five-friend usability study; no demo or submission work.
fixes: No-fit notices and copied check-ins belong to the current planning revision and disappear when an offer opens, without remounting private form drafts.
Published cancellation terms and supported payment/cancellation workflow are available before sign-in and beside private choices; personal refunds are not invented or promised.
Collection selection explains that disclosure and a request become available after roster confirmation; both-party agreement remains required.
Essential-note guidance distinguishes session must-haves from policy questions; existing unresolved notes remain pending until their owner explicitly changes or reviews them.
Public-only copyable group check-in and role-specific recovery guidance explain who can start a new round and that approvals must be renewed.

verification.keyboard_policy_disclosure: Enter expands native summary and focus stays visible

browser_checks.scope: Actual React components in StrictMode with a loopback mock API and provider; no hosted group flow or human retest.
checks: Before fix: Keep my choices notice remained after studio issued an offer; after fix: offer link appears and stale notice/copy text disappear.
Keep my choices and copy public check-in perform zero saves or payment operations.
Saved nominee in collecting stage explicitly says chosen friend has not been asked and explains roster-confirmation timing.
Unresolved cancellation question remains a must-have requiring review; policy can be opened and no model call or save occurs.
Withdrawing/recovered participant sees authorization canceled, organizer’s next action, and fresh-approval requirement.
49.50 unsaved draft survives refresh while current saved choice changes to 62; Update stays disabled until explicit comparison.
Signed-out policy page has no overflow at phone, tablet or desktop sizes; native keyboard disclosure works.

limits: Simulated friend agents do not establish real-human usability.
No new hosted PayPal/model journey was executed.
Personal cancellation still requires studio review; no new personal refund cutoff, partial-refund or transfer feature was added.
